author: Ariadne I
title: Osc2-ADG (k=160) + Lower Curvature (λ=5e-5)
abstract: Ablation on curvature strength: Oscillatory 2nd-order SSM factors with residual copy and input-adaptive temporal gating, trained with a weaker curvature penalty (λ=5e-5) to test trade-offs between smoothness and long-horizon fidelity.
